sources.population: IMF World Economic Outlook LP via DataMapper, Oct 2026 vintage (millions converted to persons; World Bank unavailable)

fx_definition: Annual average units of local currency per 1 US dollar (calendar-year basis, Dec 31 year-end convention)
news_note: 2-3 major geopolitical events per year, editorial selection, one-line summaries
sport_note: One notable sporting event per year involving the country, editorial selection

geopolitical_news.headline: Correa elected president
geopolitical_news.summary: Rafael Correa wins November's runoff on a leftist, anti-establishment platform.

geopolitical_news.headline: Oil protests in the Amazon
geopolitical_news.summary: Violent demonstrations demand a bigger state share of petroleum revenues.

sport.headline: Best World Cup run ever
sport.summary: Ecuador reaches the last 16 in Germany before falling to England.

geopolitical_news.headline: Correa takes office
geopolitical_news.summary: He is inaugurated in January vowing a 'citizens' revolution' and a new constitution.

geopolitical_news.headline: Constituent assembly elected
geopolitical_news.summary: Correa's movement dominates the September vote to rewrite the charter.

sport.headline: Copa América group-stage exit
sport.summary: Ecuador loses all three group matches in Venezuela in a dismal Copa América campaign.

geopolitical_news.headline: Colombia's Reyes raid ruptures ties
geopolitical_news.summary: The March killing of a FARC leader on Ecuadorian soil triggers a regional crisis.

geopolitical_news.headline: New constitution approved
geopolitical_news.summary: Voters back the charter in September; Ecuador defaults on 'illegitimate' debt in December.

sport.headline: World Cup qualifying struggles
sport.summary: Ecuador sits mid-table in the race for South Africa 2010.

geopolitical_news.headline: Correa re-elected
geopolitical_news.summary: He wins April's vote under the new constitution with a first-round majority.

geopolitical_news.headline: Manta US base closed
geopolitical_news.summary: Ecuador declines to renew the American anti-drug base lease.

sport.headline: Ecuador misses South Africa 2010
sport.summary: A sixth-place finish in CONMEBOL qualifying ends Ecuador's hopes for South Africa 2010.

geopolitical_news.headline: '30S' police uprising
geopolitical_news.summary: Police revolt over benefit cuts on September 30; Correa is trapped in a hospital for hours.

geopolitical_news.headline: Coup attempt alleged
geopolitical_news.summary: The government calls the mutiny a coup; several people die in the clashes.

sport.headline: Benítez stars in Mexico
sport.summary: Christian Benítez finishes as a top scorer in the Mexican league.

geopolitical_news.headline: Referendum backs judicial reforms
geopolitical_news.summary: Voters approve Correa's May package amid opposition cries of power-grabbing.

geopolitical_news.headline: El Universo libel case
geopolitical_news.summary: A court fines the newspaper and jails its directors in a suit brought by Correa.

sport.headline: Copa América group-stage exit
sport.summary: Ecuador draws twice but fails to advance in Argentina.

geopolitical_news.headline: Assange granted asylum
geopolitical_news.summary: Ecuador shelters the WikiLeaks founder in its London embassy in June.

geopolitical_news.headline: Chevron ordered to pay billions
geopolitical_news.summary: Courts uphold a massive judgment against the oil giant over Amazon pollution.

sport.headline: World Cup qualifying push
sport.summary: Ecuador climbs into the automatic qualifying places, building momentum toward Brazil 2014.

geopolitical_news.headline: Correa re-elected again
geopolitical_news.summary: He wins February's vote with a wide margin for a third term.

geopolitical_news.headline: Yasuní-ITT initiative abandoned
geopolitical_news.summary: Correa scraps the plan to leave Amazon oil untapped, citing insufficient funds.

sport.headline: Benítez dies suddenly
sport.summary: Star striker Christian Benítez dies of a heart attack in Qatar in July aged 27.

geopolitical_news.headline: Oil price crash hits economy
geopolitical_news.summary: Plunging crude prices strain the dollarized economy and public finances.

geopolitical_news.headline: Correa's popularity wanes
geopolitical_news.summary: Austerity measures and the oil-price crash erode support for the once-dominant president.

sport.headline: World Cup group-stage exit
sport.summary: Ecuador draws with France but fails to advance in Brazil.

geopolitical_news.headline: Protests over inheritance taxes
geopolitical_news.summary: Months of demonstrations erupt against proposed tax and constitutional changes.

geopolitical_news.headline: Indefinite re-election approved
geopolitical_news.summary: The assembly scraps term limits in December, though Correa pledges not to run.

sport.headline: Flying start to 2018 qualifying
sport.summary: Ecuador wins its first four qualifiers, including a famous victory in Argentina.

geopolitical_news.headline: Devastating 7.8 earthquake
geopolitical_news.summary: The April 16 Pedernales quake kills hundreds and flattens coastal towns.

geopolitical_news.headline: Reconstruction begins
geopolitical_news.summary: The government launches a massive rebuilding effort amid corruption claims.

sport.headline: Copa América quarter-final run
sport.summary: Ecuador reaches the knockouts in the United States before losing to the hosts.

geopolitical_news.headline: Moreno elected president
geopolitical_news.summary: Lenín Moreno narrowly wins April's runoff as Correa's chosen successor.

geopolitical_news.headline: Break with Correa begins
geopolitical_news.summary: Moreno swiftly distances himself from his mentor, stunning the left.

sport.headline: Ecuador misses Russia 2018
sport.summary: A late collapse in qualifying ends World Cup hopes.

geopolitical_news.headline: Referendum ends indefinite re-election
geopolitical_news.summary: Voters back Moreno's February package, barring Correa from returning.

geopolitical_news.headline: Border journalists murdered
geopolitical_news.summary: Dissident FARC fighters kill an El Comercio press team, shocking the nation.

sport.headline: No World Cup for Ecuador
sport.summary: Ecuador watches the Russia 2018 World Cup from home after a late qualifying collapse.

geopolitical_news.headline: October fuel-subsidy protests
geopolitical_news.summary: An IMF-backed decree scrapping subsidies ignites 11 days of indigenous-led unrest.

geopolitical_news.headline: Decree repealed, government retreats
geopolitical_news.summary: Moreno withdraws the measure after deaths and chaos in Quito.

sport.headline: Copa América group-stage exit
sport.summary: Ecuador goes out winless in Brazil, finishing bottom of its Copa América group.

geopolitical_news.headline: COVID devastates Guayaquil
geopolitical_news.summary: Bodies pile up in the streets in April as the health system collapses.

geopolitical_news.headline: Debt restructuring agreed
geopolitical_news.summary: Ecuador seals an IMF-backed deal to ease its crushing obligations.

sport.headline: Football suspended by pandemic
sport.summary: Leagues and qualifiers halt; play resumes behind closed doors.

geopolitical_news.headline: Lasso elected president
geopolitical_news.summary: Banker Guillermo Lasso wins April's runoff, ending a decade of leftist rule.

geopolitical_news.headline: Prison massacres shock nation
geopolitical_news.summary: Gang wars inside penitentiaries kill scores through the year.

sport.headline: Copa América quarter-final run
sport.summary: Ecuador reaches the Copa América knockouts in Brazil before losing to eventual champions Argentina.

geopolitical_news.headline: June indigenous protests
geopolitical_news.summary: CONAIE leads 18 days of roadblocks over fuel and living costs.

geopolitical_news.headline: Violence spirals
geopolitical_news.summary: Homicides soar as drug gangs battle for trafficking routes.

sport.headline: World Cup group-stage exit
sport.summary: Ecuador beats Qatar in the opener but fails to advance; the Castillo eligibility saga overshadows.

geopolitical_news.headline: Lasso dissolves parliament
geopolitical_news.summary: Facing impeachment, he invokes 'muerte cruzada' in May, triggering snap elections.

geopolitical_news.headline: Villavicencio assassinated
geopolitical_news.summary: Anti-corruption candidate Fernando Villavicencio is murdered in Quito in August.

geopolitical_news.headline: Noboa elected president
geopolitical_news.summary: Daniel Noboa wins October's runoff at 35, the country's youngest president.

sport.headline: Qualifiers begin with points deduction
sport.summary: Ecuador starts 2026 qualifying on minus three points over the Castillo case.

geopolitical_news.headline: 'Internal armed conflict' declared
geopolitical_news.summary: Noboa declares war on gangs in January after a TV station is stormed live on air.

geopolitical_news.headline: Mexican embassy raided
geopolitical_news.summary: Police storm the embassy in April to arrest ex-VP Glas, rupturing diplomatic ties.

sport.headline: Copa América quarter-final run
sport.summary: Ecuador loses to Argentina on penalties in the Houston quarter-final after a late equalizer.

geopolitical_news.headline: Noboa re-elected
geopolitical_news.summary: He defeats Luisa González in April's runoff on a hardline security platform.

geopolitical_news.headline: Blackouts and gang war persist
geopolitical_news.summary: Drought-driven power cuts compound the security crisis as Noboa begins his full term.

sport.headline: World Cup 2026 qualification secured
sport.summary: Ecuador books its ticket with games to spare despite the points deduction.
